descriptionHtml:
Bug B01 · P0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused). Re-check 2026-10-16 on 25acd727: still there (convex/ai/vision.ts, modelJson.ts and vertex.ts unchanged since e02167f). With a scripted read, everything after the read passes locally (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S17); the cases stay failed until a real photo is read. Re-check 2026-10-17 on dev 25acd727 (TFA-92580, TC-02): 14 of 14 photo reads empty while the model answered (gemini-3.6-flash, ok, 2.3–9.9 s); in-process on 25acd727 code a ```json-fenced reply gives 0 rows and bare JSON 3.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S18, TC-09/S04, TC-09/S06, TC-09/S07, TC-09/S08, TC-09/S17, TC-02/S01, TC-02/S02, TC-02/S06, TC-02/S07, TC-02/S08, TC-02/S16

Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S14 AI Check: a hard-to-read name is flagged, not guessed (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 AI Check: on a list with one hard-to-read name, the app flags that name as unclear and does not guess a plausible-looking one. … (UAT TC-02 AI Check; TFA-92580 AC 6; UAT 3.2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U7 A scan never invents an MRN, room or name. A field the photo did not have is left blank and flagged. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 6; TFA-92580 How it works 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Ten photos, each with 4 legible rows and 1 name a person cannot read. Each truth JSON records, per photo, the hidden name and the fragment a person can still see

When Each photo is read by scanCensusSheet in its mode and then by the client's own clean-up (cleanScannedName + isLikelyPatientRow for Hospital, extractedResidents for Nursing Home)

Then The unreadable row is still there, marked unclear, with no plausible name in its place. The 4 legible rows are read correctly

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per photo, on the row at room 605 / unit Birch 15 after the client clean-up. Pass: its name matches /\?|\[unclear\]|\bunclear\b|\billegible\b|unreadable/i, or the row carries unclear: true and S28 shows the scan sheet displays that flag (a field the client does not show is 'flag not shown', Fail). Fail (silent drop): the row is missing; …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.
